preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly |s| lines, one for each suffix starting from the longest to the shortest.

postconditions.expression: all((len(line.split()) == 1 and len(line.split()[0]) == 0) or (len(line.split()) == 2 and line.split()[0].isdigit()) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains either a single '0' (for empty result) or a length integer followed by the string representation.

postconditions.expression: all((len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0] == '0') or (int(line.split()[0]) == len(line.split()[1]) if len(line.split()[1]) <= 10 else (len(line.split()[1]) == 8 and line.split()[1][5:7] == '...')) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: For non-empty results, if the length is <= 10, the string is printed fully; if > 10, it is truncated to first 5 chars + '...' + last 2 chars.

postconditions.expression: all((len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0] == '0') or (int(line.split()[0]) == len(line.split()[1]) if len(line.split()[1]) <= 10 else (len(line.split()[1]) == 8 and line.split()[1][5:7] == '...')) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: The length printed matches the actual length of the resulting string (before truncation in display).

postconditions.expression: all((len(line.split()) == 1 and line.split()[0] == '0') or (int(line.split()[0]) == len(line.split()[1]) if len(line.split()[1]) <= 10 else (len(line.split()[1]) == 8 and line.split()[1][5:7] == '...')) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line corresponds to the lexicographically smallest string obtainable from the respective suffix by removing disjoint adjacent equal character pairs.
